notes.subject: ruakh
notes.rationale: 'ruakh e nkula' — moya wa Adonai goba moya ka boretho; ka bobedi di dumelelwa

notes.subject: go tšwa lefelong la gagwe
notes.rationale: mimiqomo: 'go tšwa lefelong la gagwe' (go tlošwa) goba 'lefelong la gagwe' (go rapela); KJV/JPS di fapana

notes.subject: leo le reng
notes.rationale: go gagabala gwa modumu Seheberung ga se bolele go re — Seheberu se tloša phumulo ya go bolela; taelo e okeditšwe

translation: Gomme ruakh e nkula, gomme ka kwa ka morago ga ka lentšu la modumo wo mogolo wa go gagabala, leo le reng: Tšhwaregolo tša Yahwe go tšwa lefelong la gagwe.

tokens.gloss: modumo wo mogolo wa go gagabala
